architecture_decisions: Bounded GitHub source reads: Repository/default-head, recursive tree, and UTF-8 file reads return only exact bounded #62 result types and reject provider truncation, unsupported.
work_items: Implement concrete server-owned GitHub and Vercel preview clients underneath the exact accepted `GitHubProviderClient` and `VercelProviderClient` Protocols from #62 without broadening the accepted #45/#62 authority model.
validations: The concrete clients translate one already-authorized typed provider action into one bounded authenticated provider API operation, preserve canonical Project, repository, source revision, and accepted source-lineage binding, normalize failures into bounded secret-safe provider errors, support safe idempotent retry, and keep Vercel preview as the autonomous deployment ceiling.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — This approved `P2-V0.15.7` specification exists on `ws/app-provider-clients` before substantive client implementation and passes the protected workstream specification gate.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — The workstream implements the existing `GitHubProviderClient` and `VercelProviderClient` method signatures without modifying #62 `common.py`, `github.py`, or `vercel.py`, and without adding a generic provider action surface.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Concrete clients obtain provider credentials only through injected server-owned scoped credential providers. Credential leases are resource-bound, expiry-aware, redacted, absent from source control/evidence, and architecturally favor GitHub App/fine-grained and Vercel short-lived/scoped credentials rather than broad long-lived PATs.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Repository/default-head, recursive tree, and UTF-8 file reads return only exact bounded #62 result types and reject provider truncation, unsupported source modes, oversized/binary/malformed content, wrong repository/source identity, and malformed provider payloads.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Branch creation and accepted-lineage commit require exact base/parent revisions, never force-update refs, fail closed on stale/non-fast-forward state, and return deterministic bounded #62 result identities.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Exact branch/lineage-commit/PR retries reuse an already-created exact result when provable. Pull-request creation requires exact current head revision and no merge, approval, deletion, release, workflow/settings, or generic Git authority is introduced.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — The Vercel client implements only preview create/read, uses immutable server-registered Vercel Project/repository binding, sends an explicit Preview target, rejects production-branch or Production-resolved deployments, and exposes no production promotion/alias/domain/environment/secret/configuration mutation method.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Concrete clients preserve the repository/source identities supplied by the #62 action layer and accept `AcceptedSourceLineage` only through the exact existing Protocol. Client results are independently checked so provider-returned repository/source/target mismatch cannot become success.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Missing/expired credentials, timeout/connect errors, 401/403, 404, 409/422, 429, 5xx, malformed success payloads, and secret-bearing provider error bodies produce only bounded normalized `ProviderClientError` codes with no raw provider text, token, header, cookie, environment value, or external exception diagnostic leakage.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — `httpx.MockTransport` or equivalent bounded fakes prove authorized concrete GitHub read/write/PR and Vercel preview behavior plus stale parent/head, wrong repository/target, missing/expired credentials, timeout, rate limit, auth failure, 5xx, malformed/raw/secret-bearing responses, idempotent replay, and the absence of production Vercel methods.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — The worker provisions no production GitHub/Vercel credential, performs no live provider mutation/deployment, and relies on isolated deterministic provider boundaries for CI. Live preview verification remains Control Tower/Integration responsibility.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — The branch carries the authentic committed DSPy plan, is current with `integration/wave2-app-builder`, passes focused tests, full API regression, deterministic Workstream Spec Validation, Parallax P2 CI, and Bounded Autonomy Pilot on the exact final head, and has a review-ready PR targeting `integration/wave2-app-builder`. The worker does not merge or deploy.
risks: No live credential or production side effects, no live provider mutation/deployment, and no live provider side effects.
